title: Surfboard
body:
"Quite the mystery box it seems, 8 unique styles. CAUTION: might not float"

Description


Surfboards can be bought from the Radical Shack on Radical Isle for $784. Surfboards serve no purpose to the game other than being a decoration

Trivia

  • There are 8 different variations of Surfboards.
  • Surfboards used to be able to float in the water, however it seems this feature was removed with the map change.
  • The rare surfboard variants are the pink "Gurt" surfboard and the light pink surfboard.
